exp_info.description: I worked as a Marketing Manager at a travel company, where I was also responsible for training and teaching English to our tour guides. I designed and conducted language workshops to help them improve their English-speaking skills, focusing on practical communication and customer interaction. This role allowed me to combine my teaching expertise with real-world applications, ensuring the guides provided excellent service to international clients.

As a tour guide, I led groups of international travelers, providing engaging tours while ensuring clear and effective communication in English. My role involved explaining cultural and historical sites, answering questions, and adapting to the diverse needs of travelers from different backgrounds. This experience honed my ability to communicate fluently, teach cultural insights, and connect with people, making language an essential tool for creating meaningful experiences.

course_info.trial_description:
This session is about getting to know each other and understanding your goals. Here’s what we’ll cover:

- Introductions: Get to know each other and create a comfortable learning atmosphere.

- Goal Setting: Discuss your language learning journey, challenges, and objectives.

- Needs Analysis: Identify key areas for improvement and your preferred learning style.

- Course Plan Discussion: Outline how we’ll work together, including lesson structure and strategies tailored to your goals.

This session is a great opportunity to start building a personalized learning plan. Let’s get started! 😊

pro_course_detail.title: English conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
Boost your confidence and fluency in English with engaging conversation practice! 

In this class, we’ll focus on improving your speaking skills through discussions on a variety of topics tailored to your interests and goals. You’ll expand your vocabulary, refine your pronunciation, and develop natural, conversational flow. Whether you want to enhance your small talk, prepare for professional interactions, or simply speak English more confidently, this class is designed to help you succeed in a supportive and interactive environment. 

Let’s start talking! 😊

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Speaking practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Master the IELTS Speaking section with confidence!

 In this class, we’ll:

- Part-by-Part Practice: Focus on all three parts of the Speaking test – introducing yourself, discussing topics, and expressing opinions in-depth.

- Fluency & Pronunciation: Improve your natural flow, stress, intonation, and pronunciation.

- Answer Structuring: Learn how to organize your thoughts and respond effectively under time pressure.

- Personalized Feedback: Receive constructive tips to enhance your vocabulary, grammar, and overall performance.

Let’s work together to build your speaking skills and ace the test with confidence!

pro_course_detail.title: English Presentation training: Speak with Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
Deliver your best presentation with confidence and clarity! 

In this class, we’ll focus on:

- Content Review: Ensure your presentation is clear, concise, and impactful, with appropriate grammar and vocabulary.

- Delivery Skills: Improve your tone, pace, stress, and intonation to captivate your audience.

- Mock Presentation Practice: Rehearse your presentation in a supportive environment and receive personalized feedback.

- Q&A Preparation: Learn how to handle potential questions with confidence and professionalism.

Whether it’s for work, school, or a special event, I’ll help you refine your presentation and leave a lasting impression. Let’s perfect your skills together!

pro_course_detail.title: Tourism English: Professional Communication for the Industry
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn from a tourism professional with expertise in the field! 

 In this class, I’ll combine my experience and English teaching skills to help you:

- Master Industry Vocabulary: Build confidence with essential terms and phrases for interacting with travelers and professionals.

- Practice Real-Life Scenarios: Engage in role-plays for guiding tours, handling customer inquiries, and making personalized recommendations.

- Enhance Cultural Communication: Understand the language and etiquette needed to work with international guests.

- Improve Professional Writing: Develop skills for crafting emails, itineraries, and promotional content.

As someone with a strong background in tourism, I understand your challenges and can provide practical, targeted guidance to help you succeed. Let’s work together to elevate your communication skills and career!

pro_course_detail.title: Writing and Vocabulary Mastery
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed for students who want to enhance their writing skills and build topic-specific vocabulary. Here's what to expect:

- Before the lesson: You'll receive a curated vocabulary list on a chosen topic and a writing task (essay, story, or other formats).

- During the lesson: We'll review your writing together, focusing on corrections, feedback, and ways to improve.

- Speaking practice: We'll also engage in a short discussion to practice using the vocabulary from your assignment in real-life contexts.

This lesson is perfect for students aiming to improve their written expression and expand their vocabulary in a practical and engaging way.

pro_course_detail.title: Intensive English Coaching: Structure, Grammar & Vocabulary
pro_course_detail.description:
Want to take your English to the next level with a structured and disciplined approach? 

This lesson is designed for learners who aim for rapid progress through focused grammar practice, advanced vocabulary building, and structured writing exercises. 

Each session includes targeted activities, speaking practice, and personalized feedback. 

Homework assignments will reinforce learning and challenge you to improve consistently. Ideal for learners who prefer a clear roadmap to fluency with measurable progress.

course_info.trial_description:
If you are wondering what a class with me would be like, then book a trial lesson! During the trial lesson, you will receive a sample of one of the offered classes. 


📌 Conversation Practice - During this trial lesson, I'll show you what a conversation with me would be like. This conversation practice will last 30 minutes, and it will help you decide if you'd prefer a 30 minute lesson or a slightly longer lesson.


📌 General English - We will first start with getting to know each other, then you will receive a sample English lesson. After the class, we will talk about what your English goals are and how to structure future lessons to reach your goals. 


📌 Mock Interviews - Unlike my other Mock Interview Lesson, you will not need to message me anything beforehand. Instead, we will spend the first few minutes getting to know each other, then we will have a short mock interview with the most common interview questions. After the lesson, we will go over what to do for you to prepare. 

After all of my lessons, we will review what you want out of future lessons and create the best plan for you to achieve your English goals. 

I look forward to meeting you!

每次新課堂的開始都會先複習之前一課的弱項,務求温故知新, 更容易繼續學習新知識.
